summary: @servicetitan/startup preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs, renamed with obfuscator.io-style identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style Bun-compiled file with hex-name identifiers, a rotated string-array (function WV8StW), and a custom alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9); its runtime behavior cannot be resolved from the shipped bytes. The package advertises itself as a Lerna/TypeScript CLI helper and has no stated need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque init blob. The obfuscated payload runs unconditionally on every `npm install`, with the installer's user privileges, before any consumer code executes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
